sources.quote: Beta Gruis, formally named Tiaki, is the second brightest star in the southern constellation of Grus.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 3,221 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,508 K, so 153.871 solar radii.

sources.quote: It was once considered the rear star in the tail of the constellation of the (Southern) Fish, Piscis Austrinus: it, with Alpha, Delta, Theta, Iota, and Lambda Gruis, belonged to Piscis Austrinus in medieval Arabic astronomy.
